headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team]]
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: After 20 years of service, the football legend announces his farewell in a personal, handwritten letter to his country.
details: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. He shared his farewell in a personal, handwritten message spread across three pages of a simple notepad.
In his letter, Messi wrote, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left," reflecting on the years of pressure and expectations from an entire nation.
His international career spanned generations of players and coaches, featuring Olympic glory, Copa América campaigns, and the 2022 World Cup victory in Qatar where he scored twice in the final.
The farewell message was accompanied by a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen, symbolizing the reflection on his journey and the possibility of imagining turning back the clock on his career.
Messi's retirement comes after Argentina reached the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, where they faced Spain.
The message concludes with a declaration of gratitude and pride toward Argentina, focusing on his identity and connection to the country rather than statistics or trophies.
caption:
“I emptied myself, I have nothing left.” After 20 years, Lionel Messi says goodbye to the Argentina national team.

Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. He shared his farewell in a personal, handwritten message spread across three pages of a simple notepad.

In his letter, Messi wrote, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left," reflecting on the years of pressure and expectations from an entire nation.

His international career spanned generations of players and coaches, featuring Olympic glory, Copa América campaigns, and the 2022 World Cup victory in Qatar where he scored twice in the final.

The farewell message was accompanied by a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen, symbolizing the reflection on his journey and the possibility of imagining turning back the clock on his career.

Messi's retirement comes after Argentina reached the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, where they faced Spain.

The message concludes with a declaration of gratitude and pride toward Argentina, focusing on his identity and connection to the country rather than statistics or trophies.

headline_marked: 3 [[Air Force members killed]] in pickup accident at airport Third Terminal
headline: 3 Air Force members killed in pickup accident at airport Third Terminal
summary: A vehicle lost control and fell from a flyover at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on Monday night.
details: Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed and four others injured when a pickup truck lost control and fell from a flyover at the Third Terminal of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
The accident occurred around 10:20 PM on Monday, August 31, while the personnel were performing their regular duties.
The deceased have been identified as Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Jubaidul.
According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the vehicle plunged from the second floor of the terminal's flyover.
The injured personnel were immediately transported to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.
The deceased members have also been moved to CMH for further necessary procedures.
caption:
A tragic accident at the airport's Third Terminal has claimed the lives of 3 Air Force members.

Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed and four others injured when a pickup truck lost control and fell from a flyover at the Third Terminal of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

The accident occurred around 10:20 PM on Monday, August 31, while the personnel were performing their regular duties.

The deceased have been identified as Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Jubaidul.

According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the vehicle plunged from the second floor of the terminal's flyover.

The injured personnel were immediately transported to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.

The deceased members have also been moved to CMH for further necessary procedures.
